title: Julia's homepage
question: Choose how the homepage should introduce Julia and her four priorities. All directions retain Democrats on offense. Explore the priorities is a proposed action; detailed policy copy and photography remain open.

options.label: The Broadcast Lineup
options.thesis: A bold campaign introduction leads into four clearly labeled issue bands.
options.viewport: Julia's name and Democrats on offense fill a blue masthead; four issue rows form the lineup below.
options.risk: Broadcast language must stay a reading guide, with no fake live show or audio controls.

raised.raise: Every topic gets a clearly bounded reading area with strong text contrast.
One deliberate active-topic marker supplies rhythm without competing animations.
Julia's full name owns the composition; supporting labels stay restrained.
Wide bands carry the page's narrative instead of a stack of disconnected cards.
Keyboard focus and the selected topic must be unmistakable at a glance.

options.label: The Playbook
options.thesis: The football theme becomes a readable four-part plan rather than decoration.
options.viewport: A large Democrats on offense headline sits beside a route diagram; the four priorities form the next section.
options.risk: The most familiar football interpretation; labels must keep it from becoming a sports-team site.

options.label: The Civic Poster
options.thesis: A disciplined poster grid makes Julia and the four priorities immediately legible.
options.viewport: Julia's name occupies the main grid; a blue field module and four compact issue rows sit alongside.
options.case: Strong product clarity; less connection to the brief's football identity than the lineup.
options.risk: The grid can feel institutional unless Julia's personal story follows the opening.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Overlapping issue sheets reveal Julia's priorities one at a time.
options.viewport: A campaign sheet overlaps four hatched issue records.
options.case: Weaker audience identification and slower reading of the four priorities.
options.risk: The editing metaphor can suggest evidence manipulation rather than civic clarity.

options.label: Rhythm Machine
options.thesis: Four issue keys activate a corresponding reading panel.
options.viewport: Julia's introduction appears above a row of four topic controls.
options.case: Weaker identification with the football brief and extra controls obscure straightforward reading.
options.risk: Playback conventions would imply audio that this campaign has not supplied.

options.label: Pop Record Sleeve
options.thesis: Julia's name and a future portrait lead, with four issues arranged as track titles.
options.viewport: A full-color portrait sleeve carries a small four-topic index.
options.case: Weaker fit with the football brief and small track labels underplay the issues.
options.kept: One dominant identity, restrained supporting labels.
options.risk: A portrait has not been supplied and cannot be invented as Julia's likeness.

options.label: Night Cityscape
options.lineage: City skyline, street, and reflection bands
options.thesis: Four civic priorities unfold across a layered city scene.
options.viewport: Julia's message sits above four stacked civic scene bands.
options.case: Weaker football identification; scenery competes with the candidate and issue names.
options.kept: Continuous wide bands establish a coherent reading sequence.
options.risk: Generic city imagery could misrepresent Macon and imply nonexistent civic data.

options.label: Luminous Understory
options.thesis: A branching path links Julia's four priorities with focused destinations.
options.viewport: Four issue destinations branch from Julia's introduction.
options.case: Weaker civic identification and a less obvious reading order than labeled issue bands.
options.kept: An unmistakable focus and selected state.
options.risk: Proximity-driven navigation could hide content or exclude keyboard and touch users.

canonCard.label: The Traditional Campaign Homepage
canonCard.thesis: A familiar campaign introduction followed by priorities and biography sections.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional name-and-headline hero introduces Julia, followed by four priorities.
canonCard.risk: Familiar and readable, but less distinctive; campaign photography is still needed.
